name: Kubernetes Blue-Green Deployment Setup
summary: Implement a blue-green deployment strategy on GKE to minimize downtime and risks during application updates.
description: This project involves the implementation of a blue-green deployment strategy on Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) to ensure seamless application updates with minimal downtime and reduced risk. The blue-green deployment technique allows for two identical environments, 'blue' and 'green', where one environment serves live traffic while the other is idle. During updates, the new version of the application is deployed to the idle environment, and once verified, traffic is switched over to it. This approach not only enhances the reliability of application updates but also provides a quick rollback option in case of issues. The project will include setting up the necessary Kubernetes configurations, automating the deployment process, and conducting thorough testing to ensure that the transition between environments is smooth and efficient. By adopting this strategy, businesses can significantly improve their deployment processes and maintain high availability for their users.
deliverables: Kubernetes configuration files for blue-green deployment (document)
